title: Ruling
description: A settled decision: which option was chosen and why. The rule-decision transition writes this to init/decisions/ruled/<id>.md and DELETES init/decisions/open/<id>.md (the git move that flips the unforgeable 'no open forks' guard).

id.description: Must equal the id of an existing open decision under init/decisions/open/.

chosen.description: The name of the chosen option (must match one of the open decision's option names).

rationale.description: Why this option was chosen over the others.

ruled_by.description: Audit identity of who ruled (human name or role).
